reasoning: The question asks whether the Federal Reserve's interest rate on reserve balances (IORB) will increase between October 26, 2025 and November 2, 2025. This is a 7-day window. The IORB is set by the Board of Governors and is a key monetary policy tool. The Fed typically changes rates at scheduled FOMC meetings (roughly every 6 weeks). There is no FOMC meeting scheduled between these dates based on the standard meeting calendar. Without a scheduled policy decision, the IORB rate would remain unchanged. The probability of an unscheduled rate change in this narrow window is very low.
